fields.description: Atélis at d3 is a SOM-designed waterfront residential tower in Dubai Design District. One- to four-bedroom apartments are complemented by four-bedroom Sky Villas and five-bedroom penthouses, with curved balconies and layouts facing the waterfront or wider skyline.

research.community: Atélis at d3 · Dubai Design District
overview: The Sky Villas and penthouses span two levels. Their quoted total is repeated on upper and lower drawings and should be counted once. Large terraces can make up a substantial part of the total; the suite and outdoor columns need separate attention.
research.locationNote: Dubai Design District beside the Creekside shoreline, with Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary toward the east and the city skyline toward the west. Wider district proposals and promotional travel times are not guaranteed building entitlements.
research.priceNote: The linked sheet lists AED 2.1 m one bedroom; 3.8 m two; 4.9 m two plus maid; 7.4 m three; 10.4 m four; 13 m Sky Villa; 21.6 m penthouse. These guides do not confirm present inventory or a selected unit’s current offer.
research.paymentNote: Current linked sheet: 20% booking; 10% October 2025; 5% February 2026; 10% July 2026; 10% December 2026; 10% May 2027; 10% September 2027; 25% August 2029 handover. Older dated launch calendars differ; confirm the selected contract and remaining balance.
research.handoverNote: The linked developer sheet estimates August 2029, corroborated by Property Finder. Earlier indexed material gave July 2029; dates depend on the applicable release and contract.
